blockers.wanted: a busyness knob on a dense rain (100-500 drops/s) whose density claim passes
blockers.tried: poisson rate macro 120..900 exp: the measured density peaked around 100 events/s and then fell (81, 98, 101, 83, 52)
blockers.workaround: mapped the knob to a 25..300 /s range and a lower default (150/s); density then rises 20 -> 85

blockers.workaround: reported both; added a pink body band and a noise hiss bed to lift the full-band figure from 0.35 to 0.62
